title: adenoderris glandulosa
intro: Adenoderris glandulosa, commonly known as Chinese goldenseal or Cangzhi, is a plant species native to China and other parts of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adenoderris glandulosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
